answer: Bond per identity: 500 POA, escrowed 30 days. A failed audit publishes the event with address, juror set and the delta between claimed and actual output. Numbers from the last rotation: 1,000 identities, 1,000 bonds, 500k POA locked, 12 failures published, 6k POA slashed. Vesting spreads rewards over 100 epochs, so a farm holding 1,000 bonds keeps 500k POA idle for a month and collects nothing until the tail unlocks. A vertex with no inbound attestation cannot post the first bond, so fresh addresses in the shale tier cannot bootstrap 1,000 slots in a week.
